notes: IVA 14% standard rate (Ministry of Finance taxpayer portal). The portal's exemption lists contain no domestic gold exemption; gold imports are exempt only when made by the Banco Nacional de Angola, so retail bullion carries 14%. Import duty HS 7108 null: the current Pauta Aduaneira line could not be read on an official page. No dealer bar list found.
